meta.name: settings
meta.description: Interactive settings menu for nyann preferences. View current values in a table, then pick one setting to change at a time via AskUserQuestion. Re-runnable anytime — does not require a full setup wizard. TRIGGER when the user says "change nyann settings", "nyann preferences", "configure nyann settings", "update my preferences", "toggle triage", "disable sentinel", "enable session triage", "/nyann:settings", "show nyann settings", "nyann config". ALSO trigger on direct shortcut: "/nyann:settings <key> <value>" — skip the menu and write the value directly. Do NOT trigger on "/nyann:setup" — that is the first-run wizard. Do NOT trigger on "/nyann:check-prereqs" — that inspects host tools, not nyann config.
